card.fires_on: A single digit, or the decimal point after it, right where a ".0" is about to follow (as in 2.0, 4.0, 1.0, 6.0). It is seen in version names, ranges, tables and doses.

modes.label: Digit before .0
modes.description: A whole-number digit where the next characters are ".0" in a version name, range or table value.

modes.label: Point after digit
modes.description: The decimal point itself after a whole number, just before a zero.

modes.label: Dose digit
modes.description: A whole-number dose digit followed by units, where a trailing zero could be written.

card.writes: It promotes zero-related tokens, so it pushes the model to write a 0 after the decimal point.
card.plain: It fires on a whole number when the next thing written is likely to be ".0", such as 2.0 or 4.0.
